irontech-molly-166cm-2-0-s44-ros-max-sil.heading: Unwind in Golden Luxury
irontech-molly-166cm-2-0-s44-ros-max-sil.paragraph: The evening gala has finally dissolved into a hush, leaving only the low amber glow of the lounge. Molly reclines against the tufted gold frame of the ornate sofa, her long blonde waves spilling over the beige upholstery like silk. A few strategic straps and a wisp of white fabric are the only things standing between you and the E-cup curves of her full-silicone body. She watches you with dark, heavy-lidded eyes, her lips parted in a silent invitation to forget the crowd. At 166 cm (5 ft 5 in) and 37.5 kg (82.7 lb), her weight is a grounding presence as you draw her closer. The night is still early, and Molly is ready to play.
